summary: Steep residential kerb with houses 6-10 m away for most of it.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m for most of it

best_section.where: west kerb near the bottom, by the junction with the main road

drivers.seclusion: Nearest houses 14-22 m at the bottom end, with homes on the opposite side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; at the bottom it meets a busy junction with little room clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Close to a busy road and overpass at the bottom; quiet higher up.
drivers.convention: Residents park here, but a van would sit right beside homes.

flags: Steep: about 13.8% mean grade, over the 12% limit
Dwellings 6-10 m from kerb for most of the stretch
Noise from the busy road and overpass at the bottom
sun_shade: Mostly open at the bottom; heavy tree shade at the top.
